summary: One concrete contract violation: null payloads are accepted despite the task requiring IllegalArgumentException.

findings.description: A null payload is converted to an empty string, so sign(secret, null) returns a signature and verify can authenticate it. Although the approved plan permits this, the task explicitly prohibits null payloads and requires IllegalArgumentException for invalid sign inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate payload alongside secret in both public methods and throw IllegalArgumentException when payload is null; remove the null-to-empty conversion.
